intro: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.
body: Who we are: Indian e-Visa Online, part of the Unique Visa Services group, 61 Mosley Street, Suite 6, Manchester M2 3HZ. We are the data controller for the personal information you give us.

What we collect: when you contact us or apply through our forms, we collect the information needed to prepare your visa application. This includes your name, contact details, date and place of birth, passport details, family details, travel plans, work details, photo and the documents you upload. The Indian visa form also asks for some sensitive information, such as religion and any criminal record, which we collect only because the official form requires it.

Why we use it: we use your information to check your eligibility, prepare and submit your visa application to the Government of India, contact you about it, and keep the records we’re required to keep. Our legal basis is the contract between us, your consent where we ask for it, and our legal obligations.

Who we share it with: we share your information with the Government of India through its visa systems, as needed to submit your application. Our website, forms and email are provided by service providers who process data on our behalf, such as Netlify (website and form submissions). We never sell your information.

How long we keep it: we keep application documents only as long as needed to complete your application and deal with any questions, then delete them, unless the law requires us to keep records for longer.

Your rights: you can ask for a copy of your information, ask us to correct or delete it, or object to how we use it. Contact us using the details on our contact page. If you’re unhappy with how we handle your information, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ico.org.uk).
Cookies: our website uses only the cookies and browser storage needed for it to work, such as saving your form answers on your own device until you send them.
title: Privacy Policy | Indian e-Visa Online Service
description: Our privacy policy explains how Indian e-Visa Online collects, uses, shares and protects your personal information, and your rights under UK law.

sections.heading: Changes to this privacy policy
sections.text: We may update this privacy policy when the law or our services change. The latest version is always on this page.

faqs.q: How do I ask for my information to be deleted?
faqs.a: Contact us by email or phone and we’ll confirm once it’s done, unless the law requires us to keep it.

faqs.q: Who can I complain to about this privacy policy?
faqs.a: The Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.
